inputs.name: LocalDocumentAdapter.constructor.file
inputs.description: Path of the JSON document: read() reads it with readFile, and each update() creates missing parent directories with mode 0o700, writes a temporary file beside it with mode 0o600, and renames that file over it. Undefined or an empty string keeps the document in memory only, and the adapter is for private app-data only, never session credentials or canonical artifacts.

inputs.name: LocalDocumentAdapter.constructor.empty
inputs.description: Callback that returns the initial document: the constructor calls it once and keeps the result as the in-memory copy. When a configured file does not exist (ENOENT), read() and update() call it again and use its result without validation.

inputs.name: LocalDocumentAdapter.update.change
inputs.description: Callback that receives the current document, read from the file or from memory, and may mutate it; the mutated value is what gets written, and a synchronous throw skips the write. Its return value resolves update(), but a returned promise is not awaited before the write, so the write can happen before it settles.

outputs.name: LocalDocumentAdapter.read
outputs.description: The document: the parsed file content cast to T without validation, the value from empty() when the configured file does not exist (ENOENT), or a structured clone of the in-memory copy when no file is set. read() does not wait for pending update() calls, so it returns the document as of the last completed write.

outputs.name: LocalDocumentAdapter.update
outputs.description: The value that change returned, resolved only after the document has been written. Updates run one at a time in call order, and a failed update does not block later updates.

errors.name: empty() error
errors.description: Any value thrown by the empty callback; the constructor throws it, and read() or update() rejects with it when a configured file does not exist (ENOENT).

errors.name: DataCloneError
errors.description: Thrown by structuredClone when no file is set and the document, or a value that change adds to it, cannot be copied, such as a function; read() or update() rejects with it and the in-memory copy is unchanged.

errors.name: NodeJS.ErrnoException
errors.description: A readFile error other than ENOENT, or an error from mkdir, writeFile or rename while writing; read() or update() rejects with it, and the existing document file is not replaced.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Thrown by JSON.parse when the configured file exists but does not contain valid JSON, including an empty file; read() or update() rejects with it.

errors.name: change() error
errors.description: The value thrown synchronously by change, or the reason of a promise it returns that rejects; update() rejects with it. A synchronous throw skips the write, but a returned promise is not awaited first, so the write still runs before the rejection.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Thrown in file mode when the document cannot be turned into JSON text, such as a circular reference or a BigInt; update() rejects with it, and the existing document file is not replaced.

outputs.name: LocalDocumentAdapter.read
outputs.description: The document: the parsed file content cast to T without validation, the value from empty() when the configured file does not exist (ENOENT), or a structured clone of the in-memory copy when no file is set. read() does not wait for pending update() calls, so it returns the document as of the last completed write.

errors.name: DataCloneError
errors.description: Thrown by structuredClone when no file is set and the in-memory document contains something it cannot copy, such as a function; read() rejects with it.

errors.name: NodeJS.ErrnoException
errors.description: Any readFile error other than ENOENT; read() rejects with it, while ENOENT returns the empty() value instead.

errors.description: Thrown by JSON.parse when the configured file exists but does not contain valid JSON, including an empty file; read() rejects with it.

errors.description: Any value thrown by the empty callback, which the constructor calls to create the in-memory copy; the same value is thrown and no instance is created.
